facts.fact: According to a Kinsta statistic cited by StackAdapt, nearly 87% of B2B marketers use email for content distribution.
facts.quote: Nearly [87% of B2B marketers](https://kinsta.com/blog/email-marketing-statistics/) use email for content distribution.

facts.fact: According to an Omnisend statistic cited by StackAdapt, automated emails deliver 52% higher open rates than manual sends.
facts.quote: Automated emails deliver [52% higher open rates]

facts.fact: StackAdapt's article states that automated emails deliver 332% higher click-through rates than manual sends, citing no specific source in the excerpt.
StackAdapt's article states that automated emails deliver 2,361% higher conversion rates compared to manual sends.
facts.quote: an astonishing 2,361% higher conversion rates compared to manual sends.

facts.fact: According to an EmailToolTester source cited by StackAdapt, email delivers between $36 and $44 in return for every $1 spent.
facts.quote: email delivers between $36–$44 for every $1 spent

facts.fact: StackAdapt's article states that automated campaigns generate 320% more revenue than manual sends.
facts.quote: with automated campaigns generating 320% more revenue than manual sends.

facts.fact: The article states that unlike short 30-day consumer journeys, B2B attribution needs tracking windows lasting months.
facts.quote: Unlike short 30-day consumer journeys, B2B needs months-long tracking so early-stage content still gets credit at close.

facts.fact: The article lists HubSpot, Marketo, and Customer.io as examples of marketing automation platforms (MAPs) for building automated email workflows.
facts.quote: Tools like HubSpot, Marketo, or Customer.io serve as the foundation for building and scheduling automated email workflows.

facts.fact: The article states that GDPR, CAN-SPAM, and evolving privacy regulations require built-in consent management, unsubscribe logic, and data governance in the email stack.
facts.quote: GDPR, CAN-SPAM, and evolving privacy regulations require built-in consent management, unsubscribe logic, and data governance.

facts.fact: The StackAdapt article was published on August 5, 2025.
